title: The Stolen Valor
logline: A celebrated war hero who actually fled the battle needs a pilot to silence a vengeful survivor trying to broadcast the truth.

roles.description: Scarred, missing limbs, completely consumed by rage.
A massive orbital memorial built to honor the fallen.
A flashy, unarmed luxury cruiser used for parades.
A powerful political organization of former soldiers.

public_situation: The {role:veterans_guild} is hosting a massive memorial gala at {role:monument_station} to honor the {role:fraudulent_hero}.
private_truth: The hero abandoned their squad to die in the dying star system. The survivor lived and has the flight logs to prove it.

beats.public_change: The gala preparations begin, drawing thousands of spectators.

missions.reason: The hero hires the pilot to deliver pristine ice for the gala's ice sculptures, hoping to project an image of prosperity.
missions.private_fact: The hero is visibly terrified and surrounded by bodyguards.

beats.public_change: The survivor hacks the station's public address system to play a snippet of the hero begging for mercy.

missions.reason: The survivor asks the pilot to meet a sympathetic guard at the station's security dock and collect the access codes for the main broadcast array.
missions.private_fact: The guard was actually killed by the hero's mercenaries, who are waiting in ambush.

beats.public_change: The survivor prepares to broadcast the full coward's log to the entire sector.

missions.reason: The hero pays the pilot an exorbitant sum to destroy their own yacht—which the survivor has hijacked—and recover the broadcast core before it finishes transmitting.
missions.private_fact: The survivor begs the pilot to let the broadcast finish so the dead can finally be honored.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the broadcast core. The truth is right there. The hero is demanding it back.

options.label: Return the core to the hero
Broadcast the truth to the sector

resolutions.summary: The truth is suppressed. The survivor is dismissed as a traumatized lunatic, and the hero continues their glorious, fraudulent career.
The coward's log plays on every screen. The hero is ruined, stripped of their medals, and imprisoned for desertion. The dead are finally honored.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot exposed a celebrated war hero as a coward to honor a ruined survivor.

resolutions.summary: The hero's mercenaries easily blow the unarmed yacht out of the sky before the broadcast finishes. The truth dies with the survivor.

loose_threads.detail: The hero didn't just flee; they were paid by the enemy faction to abandon that specific outpost.
The guild leadership actually knew the hero was a fraud, but covered it up to maintain recruitment numbers.

radio_hooks: {role:fraudulent_hero} speaks about the heavy burden of command.

voice_direction.fraudulent_hero: Smooth, practiced, sounds exactly like a recruitment ad.
voice_direction.vengeful_survivor: Harsh, broken, speaks through gritted teeth.
